note: BH-7877. Per-project share weight in the fleet slot allocator, settings row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.weight` (project lowercased). A project gets free slots in proportion to its weight among the projects with queued work. No row, or a value that is not a whole number of at least 1, reads as 1. project-6-os is seeded 3. Has no effect while `lane.fly-pool.fleet_slots` (FLEET_SLOTS) is unset or 0.
